Summarize dated monitoring decisions across KRI signal snapshots

Source: R/MakeActionSummary.R
MakeActionSummary.Rd

Returns one row per current site/KRI, independently of risk score weights. Only explicit `ActionedDate` values with a populated `ActionedDateSource` establish action recency. Signal creation, resolution, and extraction dates are never substituted. The latest complete extraction is selected first.

Usage

MakeActionSummary(
  dfResults,
  dfActionLog,
  intActionWindowDays = 90L,
  dActionAsOfDate = NULL,
  dActionExtractionDate = NULL,
  bActionHistoryComplete = FALSE
)

Arguments

dfResults

Current persisted KRI result rows. Must contain one `StudyID` and one `SnapshotDate` plus `GroupLevel`, `GroupID`, `MetricID`, and `Flag`.

dfActionLog

ActionLog rows with the five-column result key, `State`, and `ExtractionDate`, for the same `StudyID` as `dfResults`. It may hold several entries per group and metric at different `SnapshotDate`s; for each group and metric the latest signal snapshot on or before `dActionSnapshotDate` is used within the selected frozen extraction. Multiple actions and signals at that snapshot are reduced using the largest configured factor. Identifiers must distinguish those rows.

intActionWindowDays

Nonnegative integer action window, inclusive at both ends. Default: 90 days.

dActionAsOfDate

Date or ISO date for assessing action age. Defaults to the results snapshot. May be later for a subsequent monitoring review.

dActionExtractionDate

`Date` or ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` cutoff for frozen ActionLog extractions. `NULL` uses the results snapshot date, or `dActionAsOfDate` in date-window mode. The latest complete extraction on or before this cutoff is selected, without filling gaps from older extractions. Set an explicit date when replaying a scoring run whose ActionLog was frozen after the data snapshot. Signal snapshot dates do not establish when action states became known.

bActionHistoryComplete

Whether the selected extraction contains the complete decision history. Default: FALSE. Incomplete history cannot establish that a KRI was never addressed or justify score exclusion.

Value

Current KRI keys and flags, last known action date, age, recency, source identifiers, coverage evidence, `RecentlyAddressed`, and an `ActionReason`. `ActionRecency` is Recent, Expired, Never, or Unknown. Never requires complete history; undated evidence remains Unknown. Dates older than the window are retained. The summary is independent of weights and does not change the original KRI results or risk score.

Details

Enrich the source-neutral ActionLog with authoritative `ActionedDate` (Date), `ActionedDateSource` (character), `ActionedFlag` (the numeric flag reviewed), and `ActionScope` (`"SiteMetric"` or `"Signal"`). These additive fields describe documented monitoring decisions, not inferred work-item activity. A dated No Action decision may qualify; automatic creation does not. Missing event data remain unknown.

A SiteMetric decision can cover repeated signals across snapshots; a Signal decision covers only its own snapshot. Increased severity, changed flag direction, mismatched optional `RiskEpisodeID`, any explicit `ActionReopened`, critical actions, or undated decisions prevent exclusion. When episode identity is unavailable, SiteMetric scope must explicitly mean that the decision applies to the ongoing site/KRI finding. Conflicting latest-day severity, scope, or episode evidence also prevents exclusion; deterministic ID ordering selects a representative audit row only. Existing ActionLogs without these additive event fields remain supported, but do not establish an action date. The extractor must obtain authoritative decision dates and evidence from its source system; a current-state read alone is not a decision history.

Examples

results <- data.frame(
  StudyID = "Study-1", SnapshotDate = as.Date("2026-11-04"),
  GroupLevel = "Site", GroupID = c("1001", "1002"),
  MetricID = "Analysis_kri0001", Flag = 2
)
actions <- results[1, ]
actions$SnapshotDate <- as.Date("2026-10-01")
actions$ExtractionDate <- as.Date("2026-11-04")
actions$State <- "Closed Action"
actions$RiskSignalID <- "RS-1"
actions$ActionID <- "ACT-1"
actions$ActionedDate <- as.Date("2026-10-15")
actions$ActionedDateSource <- "Monitoring decision"
actions$ActionedFlag <- 2
actions$ActionScope <- "SiteMetric"
MakeActionSummary(results, actions, bActionHistoryComplete = TRUE)

#>   ActionCount HasUndatedDecision HasReopenedAction HasCriticalAction
#> 1           1              FALSE             FALSE             FALSE
#> 2           0              FALSE             FALSE             FALSE
#>   HasConflictingLatestDecision LastActionedDate  ActionedDateSource
#> 1                        FALSE       2026-10-15 Monitoring decision
#> 2                        FALSE             <NA>                <NA>
#>   ActionedFlag ActionScope ActionSignalSnapshotDate   ActionState
#> 1            2  SiteMetric               2026-10-01 Closed Action
#> 2           NA        <NA>                     <NA>          <NA>

#> 2               <NA>     <NA>                <NA>           2026-11-04

#> 2              Never
